Scissors.  Scissors can destroy non-target environment cards.  Only heroes that don't run have them though.  Safety first!

posts.name: Christopher
posts.cooked:
Augh. These will take me some time. Ok, fine, I'll do the first one for now. 

Name all of the citizens in Dawn's deck, and the starting hp.

The trick on these will be to not mix their HP up with their Tactics versions, but I think I've got a handle on them.

  • Citizen Dawn: 80 HP (Ok, not really in Dawn's deck, but that's how I'm starting the list)
  • Citizens Spring, Summer, Autumn, & Winter: 6, 4, 6, & 4 HP
  • Citizens Assault & Battery: 4 & 7 HP
  • Citizens Blood, Sweat, & Tears: 5, 5, & 5 HP
  • Citizens Truth or Dare: 7 or 3 HP
  • Citizens Hammer & Anvil: 3 & 7 HP

Ok. That should be everything. As per the rules, I didn't look it up, so I'm not going to look it up now to make sure I'm right, but I'm fairly confident. To be fair, the Citizens of the Sun are sort of my jam, as it were.

I've gotta get back to significantly more pressing matters, but I will do another one of these some day...
![But it is not that day!|300x169](upload://w7hYrSWdQh3zjR244KIt70nHRaD.gif "But it is not that day!")
